home.heroSubtitle: For a home, a flat, or a large project — we deliver bricks, sand, khoa, cement and rebar on time.
home.trustLine3: Quality or quantity off — we make it right
home.productsSubtitle: Price depends on delivery location and quantity. Call or WhatsApp us for today's rate.

home.process3Body: We share the rate based on today's market.
home.process4Body: Our own trucks reach you, when we say.
home.zonesSubtitle: Our home base is Singair, Manikganj. We also go to nearby areas — a quick call will confirm.

delivery.intro: We never publish a price upfront. Price depends on three things:
delivery.factor1Body: Auto brick, picket brick, jhama — each has its own rate.
delivery.factor2Body: Per 1,000 pieces, per truck, per CFT, per bag, or per ton — whichever unit you buy in.
delivery.factor3Body: How far from Singair, and the road condition at the site.
delivery.zonesSubtitle: These are our most familiar routes. We do go beyond — please call first.
delivery.vehiclesSubtitle: Our own fleet, so on-time delivery is on us.
